title: Counterfactual Haircut Adjuster
description: Enter a program's total cost, enrollment, and gross employed-at-exit count, then set a baseline counterfactual job-finding rate, substitution rate, and creaming discount to net out deadweight, displacement, and cohort selection bias. Produces a haircut-adjusted placement count and cost-per-outcome figure alongside the unadjusted gross numbers, with a one-click handoff into the Cost-per-Outcome Ladder (#170).
data_vintage: Method-only tool: standard workforce program net-impact evaluation logic (sequential deadweight, substitution, and creaming discount). No fixed benchmark constants — every rate is user-entered and overridable, so there is nothing to refresh.
regulatory_citations: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration — WIOA net impact / counterfactual evaluation framework (deadweight, substitution, creaming)

mcp_tool_definition.name: counterfactual_haircut_adjuster
mcp_tool_definition.description: Net out deadweight, substitution, and creaming from a workforce program's gross placement count and cost, sequentially discounting to a haircut-adjusted net-impact placement count and cost-per-outcome figure.
